name: io.github.jykr/paper-sources
title: Paper Sources
description: Pooled paper search across OpenAlex, Europe PMC, PubMed, arXiv and bioRxiv, with full text.

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAlex API key for your own daily budget (optional)

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_MAILTO

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact email that enables Unpaywall open-access full text (optional)
